KIND:       AdaptiveDialog
SCHEMA:     bot (vendor/skills-for-copilot-studio @ 9c42d3a)

FIELD:      beginDialog.OnRecognizedIntent.actions <[]DialogAction>

DESCRIPTION:
    The topic body: the nodes to run, in order, when the trigger fires. A child
    agent's OnToolSelected trigger must not have actions.

    DialogAction: A node: one step in a topic's actions: list. 52 kinds covering
    messaging, questions, variables, branching and loops, topic navigation, AI
    and knowledge, integration and conversation control. Never invent a kind;
    the vendor skills call invented kinds the #1 source of hallucination errors.
    See: docs/05-nodes.md#all-node-kinds-at-a-glance

ONE OF (set `kind:`):
  InvokeFlowAction                    Runs a Power Automate cloud flow or agent flow at a fixed point in a topic, passing input…
  InvokeAIBuilderModelAction          Runs an AI Builder model or prompt by aIModelId, with input/output bindings.
  WaitForConnectorTrigger             Pauses the topic until a connector trigger fires, then continues with the trigger's outpu…
  InvokeConnectorAction               Calls a connector operation inline in a topic: no tool file, and the orchestrator isn't i…
  InvokeMcpToolAction                 Calls one tool on an MCP server at a fixed point in a topic.
  InvokeSkillAction                   Calls a Bot Framework skill (skillId, actionId).
  HttpRequestAction                   A raw HTTP call from a topic to a REST endpoint that has no connector.
  SearchAndSummarizeContent           Generative answers: searches knowledge, has the model write a grounded answer with citati…
  AnswerQuestionWithAI                Answers from conversation history and general model knowledge only; it doesn't consult kn…
  SearchAndSummarizeWithCustomModel   Generative answers like SearchAndSummarizeContent, but with an external model under model…
  InvokeCustomModelAction             Calls a custom or external model (modelConfiguration).
  SearchKnowledgeSources              Searches knowledge and returns the raw results, with no AI summary.
  AdaptiveCardPrompt                  Shows an Adaptive Card and waits until the user submits it (the UI's Ask with Adaptive Ca…
  Question                            Asks the user something and stores the recognised answer in a variable; the entity decide…
  CSATQuestion                        Asks the built-in CSAT (customer satisfaction, 1-5) rating question; the results feed Cop…
  OAuthInput                          Shows a sign-in card (title, text, resource).
  ActionScope                         Groups nodes into a block (actions).
  Foreach                             Loops over a table: items is the `=` table expression, value the loop variable, index the…
  DisconnectedNodeContainer           Holds nodes not connected to the flow: leftovers from the authoring canvas.
  BeginDialog                         Calls another topic (or child agent) and comes back when it ends.
  ActivateExternalTrigger             Switches on an external (autonomous) trigger from within a conversation and names the top…
  ReplaceDialog                       Goes to another topic and doesn't come back: the current topic is replaced.
  RepeatDialog                        Restarts the current topic.
  DisableTrigger                      Disables the trigger of the topic named in dialog.
  CancelAllDialogs                    Ends every running topic.
  CancelDialog                        Cancels the current topic, optionally raising eventName/eventValue.
  ClearAllVariables                   Resets a whole group of variables.
  BreakLoop                           Leaves the enclosing Foreach.
  ContinueLoop                        Skips to the next iteration of the enclosing Foreach.
  ResetVariable                       Clears one variable.
  EditTable                           Changes a table (list) variable in place, e.g. appending a row.
  EditTableV2                         Newer form of EditTable: changeType is an object (AddItemOperation or RemoveItemOperation…
  EmitEvent                           Raises an event (eventName, eventValue; eventType ActivityIfUnhandled, Activity or Dialog…
  EndDialog                           Ends the current topic and returns to the caller, if any.
  GetActivityMembers                  Reads the members of an activity into variable.
  GetConversationMembers              Reads the members of the conversation (e.g. a Teams group chat) into variable.
  GotoAction                          Jumps to another node in the same topic.
  ConditionGroup                      If / else-if / else.
  EndConversation                     Ends the whole conversation.
  RecognizeIntent                     Runs intent recognition on userInput.
  SendActivity                        Sends a message to the user: plain text, a template, message variations, speech, quick re…
  TransferConversation                Hands the conversation to a human agent or phone number (messageToAgent, context, telepho…

  SetVariable                         Sets a variable to a literal or a Power Fx expression; use it for almost any computation,…

  ParseValue                          Parses a value (typically JSON text) into a typed variable, using valueType (a data type).
  SignOutUser                         Signs the user out.
  LogCustomTelemetryEvent             Writes a custom telemetry event, viewable in Application Insights if it is connected.
  DeleteActivity                      Deletes a previously sent message (activityId).
  UpdateActivity                      Replaces a previously sent message (activityId, new activity).
  CreateSearchQuery                   Uses AI and the conversation history to rewrite the user's message into a self-contained …
